body:
PR #2748 ready at 90f0c63303a7661faf68f3b44cf07bd180d8b083 (0 behind origin/main).
- BUG-2001: os_wrapped_program_and_args bound headless_worktree_root() read-write even when it fell back to cwd/$HOME outside a git repository; now resolves find_project_root_from(worktree_root) and refuses outside git. Proven by session::tests::os_wrap_outside_git_refuses_instead_of_binding_cwd_rw.
- BUG-2012: contained_settings_json allowed Edit/Write on <root>/.git when a main checkout was passed without store_write_paths/extra_deny, and two BUG-1971 mutations survived; now denies <root>/.git and <root>/.git/** via contained_main_checkout_git_deny_paths(write_roots) and routes contained_session_git_root through contained_session_write_roots. Proven by tests::bug_1928_contained_boundary_tests::main_checkout_git_hooks_and_config_are_denied_by_contained_settings and tests::bug_1928_contained_boundary_tests::spawn_claude_headless_resume_forwards_contained_then_some_cwd.
